useCases: Browse apps for analytics, email, files, AI, productivity and more, then install them from your browser.
Update apps when a new version is available. Automatic updates are off until you turn them on.
Follow installs and updates in a live log, and roll back to an earlier app version when supported.
readmeSummary: Install and manage 100+ open-source apps, including OpenSEO, Sink and Counterscale.
